item_sink.configuration.item_sink.values: Include Bundled Values
Keep the existing catalogue prices beneath your pricing rules.
Pricing Rules
First match wins. Use item ids, #tags, contains:phrases, namespace:modid or wildcards, then -> tier or -> outputItem, count, ticks, FE/t.
Fallback Value
Price for items with no other match. Empty rejects them; use a tier name or outputItem, count, ticks, FE/t.
item_sink.ponder.item_sink_complete.head: Using and Automating the Item Sink
item_sink.ponder.item_sink_complete.text: Right-click the sink. Put unwanted items in its left input slot.
Attach connectors to the charged accumulator and the sink. Wrench the battery to Pull and the sink to Push.
Use a copper wire spool on both connectors to link the battery to the sink.
The connected source fills the FE buffer. The sink lights up as it uses that energy to make currency.
Turn the belts. Funnels feed accepted items from the input chest into the sink.
The extracting funnel puts currency on the output belt. Collect it in the chest.
Keep power supplied and the outputs clear. A full machine pauses until there is room again.
